checks: The longitudinal coordinate has derivative 1 along e, so the physical transverse Jacobian is 1/||a_0||. In particular ∫ℓdν is the ordinary volume V.

The two sets' intersection has offsets 1−s(a_i·e)_+. Splitting off their average 1−sσ/m leaves a sum-zero vector reached by exactly one translation by rank. At the zero average the inequalities force all translated scores to be zero, and above that s their sum contradicts feasibility.

The exact overlap volume is ∫(ℓ−s)_+dν. Bounded difference quotients give its right derivative −ν{ℓ>s}, including at zero. Every interior projected point has an interior lift by the stated convex interpolation, giving positive length away from a null boundary.

The continuous tail excludes interior atoms, its limit at L excludes the top atom since d≥2, and positivity almost everywhere excludes the zero atom. Its derivative gives the density and at zero gives P.
